result.summary: The image depicts a narrow one-way urban street with mixed-use development and row housing. While a marked continental crosswalk is present, pedestrian safety is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked directly adjacent to the crosswalk block the visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street at the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of visible curb ramps
hazards.description: No clear ADA-compliant curb ramps are visible at the crossing, potentially creating a barrier for users with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk edges at the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lane.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and prioritize pedestrian movement.
